sandbachFocus: Sandbach United did not play this week. They remain top of the First Division South table with 28 points from 12 games, maintaining their excellent form with five consecutive league wins (W-W-W-D-W most recently).
divisionWide: Bilston Town hosted Dawley Town on Wednesday 14 October 2026, with the home side looking to extend their strong run — Bilston sit 3rd with seven wins from their last six league games, while Dawley are struggling in 14th place with just one win in their last five league matches.
